'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***The [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian military]] says that it has launched [[2023 Zaporizhzhia offensive|offensive operations]] in [[Zaporizhzhia Oblast]] and "taken more advantageous lines and positions". [https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20230121-live-baltic-states-call-on-germany-to-provide-tanks-to-ukraine-now (France 24)]
*[[Tigray War]]
**[[Tigrayan peace process]]
***[[Eritrean Defence Forces|Eritrean forces]] withdraw from [[Shire (Tigray)|Shire]] and other major towns in the [[Tigray Region]] of [[Ethiopia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/eritrean-troops-seen-leaving-ethiopian-town-shire-2023-01-21/ (Reuters)] 
*[[2022–2023 Peruvian political protests]]
**[[Peru]] indefinitely closes its iconic [[Machu Picchu]] historic site due to the ongoing unrest which has killed dozens of people. Around 500 foreign nationals are currently stranded in Peru. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-64360531 (BBC News)] [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230121-peru-closes-famed-tourist-site-machu-picchu-due-to-protests (AFP via France 24)]
*[[Islamist insurgency in the Sahel]]
**[[Burkina Faso]] demands that [[French Armed Forces|French forces]] withdraw from its territory after suspending a 2018 military accord that allowed the presence of French troops in the country. The [[Patriotic Movement for Safeguard and Restoration|ruling military junta]] has given France one month to complete the withdrawal. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/burkina-military-govt-demands-departure-french-troops-national-television-2023-01-21/ (Reuters)]
*[[Yemeni Civil War (2014–present)|Yemeni Civil War]]
**Six people are injured after a bomb explodes in al-Majaza, [[Shabwah Governorate]], [[Yemen]]. [https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20230122-bomb-blast-injures-6-soldiers-in-yemens-shabwa/ (Middle East Monitor)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Japanese cuisine|Japan]] wins the 2023 [[World Pastry Cup]] in [[Chassieu]], [[Lyon Metropolis]], [[France]]. [https://www.philstar.com/lifestyle/food-and-leisure/2023/01/22/2239416/japan-wins-world-pastry-cup (AFP via ''The Philippine Star'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[International sanctions during the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[RT France]], the French arm of the [[Russia]]n [[state media]] network [[RT (TV network)|RT]], ceases operation following the [[Asset freezing|freezing]] of their bank accounts by the [[Direction générale du Trésor]]. [https://www.news18.com/news/world/russias-rt-france-to-close-after-accounts-frozen-channel-head-6887971.html (AFP via News18)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Sweden–Turkey relations]]
**The [[Ministry of National Defense (Turkey)|Turkish defense ministry]] cancels [[Minister of Defence (Sweden)|Swedish defense minister]] [[Pål Jonson]]'s upcoming visit to [[Turkey]] in response to an approval for [[Far-right politics|far-right extremist]] [[Rasmus Paludan]] to protest in front of the [[Turkish embassy]] in [[Stockholm]]. [https://jordantimes.com/news/world/turkey-cancels-sweden-minister-visit-over-planned-protest (AFP via ''The Jordan Times'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2023 Monterey Park shooting]]
**Ten people are killed and ten others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] at a dance studio after [[Lunar New Year]] celebrations in [[Monterey Park, California]], United States. The suspect, 72-year-old Huu Can Tran, escapes and later commits suicide. [https://www.latimes.com/california/story/2023-01-22/la-me-monterey-park-mass-shooting (''Los Angeles Times'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Slovak constitutional referendum]]
**[[Slovakians]] head to the polls to vote in a [[referendum]] to determine whether early elections can be called before the customary end of the mandate. [https://apnews.com/article/zuzana-caputova-slovakia-constitutions-a55ea046b6eaf7c56b057108e55e6f79 (AP)]
*[[8 January Brasília attacks|2023 Brazilian Congress attack]]
**[[Army High Command|Commander of the Brazilian Army]] Júlio César de Arruda is fired by [[President of Brazil|President]] [[Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva]] in the aftermath of the [[8 January Brasília attacks|January 8 Congress attack]] and is replaced by Tomás Miguel Ribeiro Paiva. [https://apnews.com/article/jair-bolsonaro-politics-brazil-government-caribbean-luiz-inacio-lula-da-silva-42151a9c0ea511391b990a9527754c1e (AP)]
*[[Tanzania]]n opposition party [[Chadema]] organizes a [[political demonstration]] in [[Mwanza]]. This is the country's first demonstration since [[President of Tanzania|President]] [[Samia Suluhu Hassan]] abolished her predecessor [[John Magufuli]]'s seven-year ban on [[Freedom of assembly|political assembly]] earlier this month. [https://www.voanews.com/a/tanzania-opposition-holds-first-rally-since-ban-lifted/6928184.html (AFP via VOA)]
